name: Kimi ga Nozomu Eien Another Episode - Kanashimi wa Kaze no You ni
original_name: 君が望む永遠 another episode 悲しみは風のように
source:
This is a story told by Shinji about the tree on a hill that unites people forever upon making a confession.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
慎二讲述了一个关于山丘上那棵树的故事。只要在树下告白，两人便能永远相守。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
